disconnected.title: Controller disconnected
disconnected.action: Plug the cable back in or turn the controller on again by holding the centre button.

permissionDenied.title: No permission to read the controller
permissionDenied.action: macOS: allow it under Privacy & Security > Input Monitoring. Linux: install the GamepadLab udev rule. Windows: close apps that hold the controller (DS4Windows, Steam).

driverMissing.title: Controller driver not found
driverMissing.action: Update your system and reconnect. On Windows, older Xbox controllers need the official driver.

backendUnavailable.title: Controller input unavailable
backendUnavailable.action: Restart the app. On Linux, check that udev is running and that you are in the input group.

rumbleUnsupported.title: This controller does not accept that command
rumbleUnsupported.action: Rumble, lights or adaptive triggers are not available on this controller or connection.

hidAccess.title: Could not talk to the controller
hidAccess.action: Unplug and reconnect it. If you are on Bluetooth, try a USB cable.

io.title: Could not read or save the file
io.action: Check the chosen folder, permissions and free disk space.

invalidInput.title: Invalid data
invalidInput.action: Check the file or the values and try again.

notFound.title: Item not found
notFound.action: It may have been removed. Refresh the list.

internal.title: Unexpected error
internal.action: Copy the diagnostics from Settings and open an issue on the project's GitHub.

warnings.steamRunning: Steam is open. Steam Input can remap, hide or duplicate controllers: close Steam or disable Steam Input to test the real controller.
warnings.inputMonitoring: macOS is blocking Input Monitoring. Some controllers only show up after you allow GamepadLab.
warnings.hidrawPermission: No hidraw permission: gyro, touchpad, lightbar and triggers stay unavailable until you install the GamepadLab udev rule.
warnings.virtualDevice: A virtual controller is connected (Steam Input, ViGEm…). It mirrors a real one and may show up as a copy.
